FAQ Schema Generator

Turn Q&A pairs into valid FAQPage JSON-LD schema markup.





  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Type a question and its answer.
  2. Click Add Q&A — repeat for each pair.
  3. Click Generate Schema to build the JSON-LD.
  4. Copy or download it and paste into your page.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
How do I generate FAQ schema?
Add questions and answers one by one, then click Generate — the tool builds a valid FAQPage JSON-LD block.
How many FAQs should I include?
Google shows a maximum of a few FAQs as rich results; keep questions genuinely helpful and matching visible page content.
Must the FAQs appear on the page?
Yes — Google requires the questions and answers to be visible on the page for FAQ rich results eligibility.
How do I add it to my site?
Click Copy JSON-LD and paste the block inside your page's <head> or before </body>.
